readme.text: Learn how to set it up by watching a video or reading the documentation.

streamerbot.title: Streamer.bot
streamerbot.schema_hint: Enable if Streamer.bot is on a remote server (VPS) with HTTPS/TLS. Leave it off if you don't know what you're doing 😊

speakerbot.title: Speaker.bot
speakerbot.voice_alias_hint: Set in Settings -> Voice Alias on Speaker.bot
speakerbot.warning_websocket: Speaker.bot's WebSocket need to be activated and running. Follow the tutorial.
speakerbot.warning_engine: You need to set a Speech Engine and a Voice Alias on Speaker.bot. Follow the tutorial.

general.title: Global Settings
general.demo_mode_hint: Starts ChatRD in test mode, throwing random messages and events
general.text_outline_hint: Adds a text outline to messages for better visibility
general.orientation_warning: Chat Orientation will not work if Chat Layout is set to Horizontal.
general.sound_notifications_hints: Plays an audio notification for each new message.
general.sound_notifications_list_hints: Select the sound you want to play.
general.sound_notifications_group_hint: Plays the notification again if several messages arrive in a row without a pause.
general.sound_notifications_interval_hint: Time without new messages before a pending notification plays.
general.group_messages_hint: Consecutive messages from the same user will be grouped
general.ignore_chatters_hint: Separate the usernames by commas. eg.: Streamlabs,Streamelements
general.hide_after_hint:
Hides an item after a certain amount of seconds.
Setting at zero disables it
general.platform_views_combined_hint: Combine the viewer counts from all enabled platforms.
general.chat_field_hint: Adds a chat field for you to type in your chat.
general.chat_field_warning: The Chat Field also accepts /commands. Commands Supported
general.image_embedding_filter_hint: If enabled, only images from the domains below are allowed to be embedded images. Separate them by commas. e.g: imgur.com,tenor.com,giphy.com

twitch.title: Twitch
twitch.gifted_bomb_hint: Shows when a user gifted subs massively.
twitch.gifted_bomb_train_hint: Shows the a list of users gifted by the gifted bomb.
twitch.powerups_notifications_hint: Disable this if you want the effects only, with no event notifications
twitch.pronouns_hint: Shows Pronouns to those whom enabled them on Twitch chat.
twitch.hype_train_event_hint: Shows when a Hype Train event starts, levels up and ends.
twitch.hype_train_bar_hint: Show the Hype Train Bar under the Statistics.
twitch.goal_event_hint: Shows when a Goal event starts, progress and completes.
twitch.goal_bars_hint: Show a Goal Bar for each goal under the Statistics.
twitch.seventv_paint_info: The user needs to have a 7TV Sub and Nametag Paint Enabled.
twitch.embed_images_hint: Turn image links into embedded images in ChatRD
twitch.embedding_roles_hint: Select which roles would be able to embed images.
twitch.role_selection_hint: If Speaker.bot is enabled, only the roles selected below will have their messages spoken over TTS. Events will not be filtered by this.

youtube.title: YouTube
youtube.gifted_membership_train_hint: Shows the a list of users gifted by the gifted bomb.
youtube.custom_emotes_hint: You have to add member emotes manually because YouTube's API doesn't relay them to Streamer.bot.
youtube.custom_emote_information: Don't use Discord, Imgur or any temporary image hosting platforms to host your emotes. You could right click on the emote image on YouTube and copy the image URL. Watch my Video Tutorial 😊
youtube.embed_images_hint: Turn image links into embedded images in ChatRD
youtube.embedding_roles_hint: Select which roles would be able to embed images.
youtube.role_selection_hint: If Speaker.bot is enabled, only the roles selected below will have their messages spoken over TTS. Events will not be filtered by this.

kick.title: Kick
kick.api_warning: During peak usage, Kick's API becomes unstable and takes longer to relay events. This is not an issue with Streamer.bot or ChatRD. Kick has "infinite money glitch", so I hope it gets better in the future. 😣
kick.gifted_bomb_hint: Shows when a user gifted subs massively.
kick.gifted_bomb_train_hint: Shows the a list of users gifted by the gifted bomb.
kick.raids_hint: It's like RAID on Twitch ... but on Kick
kick.embed_images_hint: Turn image links into embedded images in ChatRD
kick.embedding_roles_hint: Select which roles would be able to embed images.
kick.role_selection_hint: If Speaker.bot is enabled, only the roles selected below will have their messages spoken over TTS. Events will not be filtered by this.

tiktok.title: TikTok
tiktok.chat_field_warning: If you have Chat Field enabled, you need to follow the instructions to send messages to TikTok. Or Watch my Video Tutorial 😊
tiktok.chat_field_warning_disabled_tikfinity: WARNING: The Chat Field for TikTok was temporarily disabled. TikFinity is having issues with TikTok connectivity. Read more about it.
tiktok.role_selection_hint: If Speaker.bot is enabled, only the roles selected below will have their messages spoken over TTS. Events will not be filtered by this.
tiktok.service_save_button_hint: After changing the Service Provider, TikTok Username and/or EulerStream API key, it's important to click on the Save Service Information button.
tiktok.tikfinity_hint: To use TikFinity, you need to download their desktop app and follow the instructions. For more informations, watch the Tutorial.
tiktok.eulerstream_hint:
Using EulerStream is experimental and has rate limits!. You need to create an account on their website and use the API KEY here. Also, keep watch on your daily quota on your dashboard.
Don't change the username above while live streaming or else you will burn your free sessions.
